</div></div></div><h1 class="Heading-module-scss-module__AyGdUq__heading text-headline-1-serif Heading-module-scss-module__AyGdUq__balance">Claude for Small Business launches new workflows, integrations, and training programs</h1><div class="text-rich-text BlogPostDetail-module-scss-module__oel_OW__subheading"><p class="text-body-large-2">We’re releasing new <a href="https://claude.com/solutions/small-business">Claude for Small Business</a> workflows and integrations to help owners run and grow their business. We&#x27;re also kicking off the next leg of our Claude SMB tour, with free partner webinars and community-run workshops.</p></div></div><ul class="DetailSidebar-module-scss-module__3RcHtG__sidebar ArticleLayout-module-scss-module__W3addq__wrap"><div class="ArticleLayout-module-scss-module__W3addq__content"><div class="text-rich-text text-rich-text--article w-richtext"><p><a href="http://claude.com/plugins/small-business">Claude for Small Business</a> now includes 43 workflows and 27 new integrations with tools small businesses already use, including Shopify, Salesforce, TikTok, Atlassian, Zoom, Xero, Gusto, Square, Stripe, and Zapier. The new workflows extend Claude from running the back office to growing the business, and they arrive with a fall schedule of free in-person workshops and partner webinars for owners who want help getting started.</p><p>We launched <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-for-small-business">Claude for Small Business in May</a> as a set of connectors and ready-to-run workflows that put Claude inside the tools owners depend on. It has since been installed more than 900,000 times. Thank you to our original, and continued, partners Intuit Quickbooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365.On our spring Claude SMB Tour, more than 1,000 owners in 10 cities <a href="https://claude.com/resources/articles/what-1-000-small-business-owners-taught-us-about-ai">told us what they wanted</a> Claude to take on next. About a third asked for help growing the business: generating leads, answering inbound inquiries, and writing proposals. Many also wanted day-to-day reporting handled for them. We built this new release around those requests.</p><p>The tour returns this fall with free workshops in 10 US cities. More than 150 organizations we&#x27;ve trained as Approved Claude SMB Trainers will run over 750 workshops in their own communities, and 14 integration partners are hosting free webinars about their connectors.</p><p>Here&#x27;s what small business leaders shared with us during the first leg of our Claude SMB tour:</p><p><em>“What used to take me 120 hours now takes me five minutes. I have so much time on my hands that I can now spend more time with my family, do things I like, and pursue parts of my business that I’ve always neglected.” — <strong>Pedro Rubio, Founder and CEO, Blackfyre GovCon, Washington, D.C.</strong></em></p><p><em>&quot;I really see Claude as an equalizer for small businesses, where we can do stuff as big as a 100 person, 200 person firm now. At 40 people and scaling, that&#x27;s how we get time back for our clients and culture.&quot; — <strong>Cara Roellgen, Director of Strategy and Innovation, KBSO Consulting, Carmel, Indiana</strong></em></p><p><em>&quot;At 6:00 am every morning, it goes and looks through our CRM, gets all of the to-do list items, prioritizes them, and sends out an email saying, here&#x27;s what needs to be done today, here&#x27;s the biggest priorities. We call it the daily briefing.&quot; — <strong>Garrett French, Owner, Driller Design Co., Tulsa, Oklahoma</strong></em></p><p><em>&quot;I made $20,000 in the last month and a half using Claude to do these professional proposals. I know that&#x27;s getting the business, and it put money in my bank account. How about that?&quot; — <strong>Dan Ninerell, Founder, Modern Classical Chefs, South Jersey, New Jersey</strong></em></p><p><em>&quot;We tell it [Claude] what the end goal is. It goes and tests, and 90% of the time it gets it right. We&#x27;re a five-person company. I think we&#x27;ve done quite a bit with it.&quot; — <strong>Bill Hood, Co-Founder, TruckingMBA, Chattanooga, Tennessee</strong></em></p><p><em>&quot;The thing that makes it most beneficial to us are the integrations. We use Slack, and that&#x27;s how we talk to it. It integrates with Intuit QuickBooks. It&#x27;s pulling everything from everywhere instead of us having to find different pieces of information all over. It&#x27;s all in one place.&quot; — <strong>Kati Jo Hodges, Director of Operations, Premier Geotech and Testing, Baton Rouge, Louisiana</strong></em></p><h2 id="a-week-with-claude-for-small-business">A week with Claude for Small Business</h2><p>Here’s a week-in-the-life of a small business owner using Claude to run and grow their business, inspired by how small business owners are using Claude today.</p><div aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-week" role="navigation" aria-label="A week with Claude"><div class="sb-k">Your week with Claude</div><ol><li><div class="sb-when">Sunday, 8:00pm</div><div><a href="#sb-sun">Install and onboard</a><span class="sb-what">Connect the tools you already use and pick your first task.</span></div></li><li><div class="sb-when">Monday, 7:00am</div><div><a href="#sb-brief">The weekly brief</a><span class="sb-what">Cash, sales, pipeline, and overdue invoices on one page.</span></div></li><li><div class="sb-when">Monday, 9:40pm</div><div><a href="#sb-leads">Responding to inbound leads</a><span class="sb-what">After-hours inquiries qualified, answered, and logged.</span></div></li><li><div class="sb-when">Wednesday</div><div><a href="#sb-proposals">Writing proposals</a><span class="sb-what">A voice memo becomes a priced, branded proposal.</span></div></li><li><div class="sb-when">Thursday</div><div><a href="#sb-marketing">Unblocking marketing campaigns</a><span class="sb-what">Next week's posts and review replies, ready for your OK.</span></div></li><li><div class="sb-when">Month end</div><div><a href="#sb-close">Closing the books</a><span class="sb-what">Reconciled accounts and a close packet for your accountant.</span></div></li></ol></div></div><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-band" id="sb-sun" style="background:#dbe5ef"><div class="sb-cal" aria-hidden="true"><span class="sb-cal-d">SUN</span><span class="sb-cal-n">01</span></div><div><span class="sb-eye">Sunday, 8:00pm</span><h2>Install and onboard</h2></div></div></div><p>Claude for Small Business runs in Claude Cowork, the desktop app where Claude works directly with your files and connected tools. You install the plugin, ask Claude to “help me get set up” or run /smb-onboard, connect the tools you already use, and pick a task. The plugin can also set each workflow to run on a schedule you choose.</p><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-note"><div><span class="sb-nb">You stay in charge</span>By default, Claude does the work and waits for your approval before anything sends, posts, or pays.</div></div></div><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-how"><div class="sb-sec"><div class="sb-lbl">Run it</div><div class="sb-row"><div><span class="sb-tag">Ask</span><span class="sb-q">“help me get set up”</span></div><div><span class="sb-tag">or type</span><code>/smb-onboard</code></div></div></div></div></div><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-band" id="sb-brief" style="background:#f1d9cc"><div class="sb-cal" aria-hidden="true"><span class="sb-cal-d">MON</span><span class="sb-cal-n">02</span></div><div><span class="sb-eye">Monday, 7:00am</span><h2>The weekly brief</h2></div></div></div><p>Cash position, last week&#x27;s sales against the week before, what moved in the pipeline, which invoices are overdue, and the three things that need you this week, are on one page before you&#x27;ve opened a spreadsheet.</p><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-how"><div class="sb-sec"><div class="sb-lbl">Run it</div><div class="sb-row"><div><span class="sb-tag">Ask</span><span class="sb-q">“give me my Monday brief”</span></div><div><span class="sb-tag">or type</span><code>/monday-brief</code></div><div class="sb-rnote">Set it to “weekly” during setup and it runs at the same time every Monday, with the option to push to a standing dashboard via an artifact or website.</div></div></div><details class="sb-sec sb-acc"><summary><span class="sb-lbl">Works with</span><span class="sb-cnt">37 connectors</span></summary><div class="sb-acc-body"><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-story" style="background:#f3e3dc"><div class="sb-lbl">Owner story</div><div class="sb-who">Mothership Coffee Roasters</div><div class="sb-role">Juanny Romero, founder and CEO · Las Vegas</div><div class="sb-stats"><div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-num">22%</span>in-store margins, credited in part to tighter scheduling, ordering, and inventory reporting</div><div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-num">6</span>cafés run from one consolidated view</div></div><div class="sb-body"><div>Juanny Romero, founder and CEO of Mothership Coffee Roasters, runs six cafés plus wholesale and catering in Las Vegas. Her numbers lived in the POS, Intuit QuickBooks, Slack, and email with no single weekly view. She connected them to Claude, made Claude her leadership team's workspace for forecasting and weekly planning, and now runs all six locations from one consolidated view. In-store margins rose to 22%, which she credits in part to tighter scheduling, ordering, and inventory reporting.</div></div></div></div><figure data-flush="true"><div class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__video Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__youtubeEmbed Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__video" data-youtube-id="yxeHQvby5JY"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/yxeHQvby5JY?enablejsapi=1&amp;rel=0&amp;playsinline=1&amp;modestbranding=1" title="YouTube video" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation allow-popups" allowFullScreen="" class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__player"></iframe></div><figcaption>Claude for Small Business: Monday Brief</figcaption></figure><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-band" id="sb-leads" style="background:#e0dcec"><div class="sb-cal" aria-hidden="true"><span class="sb-cal-d">MON</span><span class="sb-cal-n">03</span></div><div><span class="sb-eye">Monday, 9:40pm</span><h2>Responding to inbound leads</h2></div></div></div><p>A catering inquiry arrives after close through your website, email, or chat. Claude qualifies it, drafts a reply with two real openings from your calendar, and logs it to your CRM. If you&#x27;ve let this workflow run on its own, you see it Tuesday morning already booked; otherwise the reply is waiting for your OK.</p><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" in”</span></div><div><span class="sb-tag">or type</span><code>/speed-to-lead</code></div><div class="sb-rnote">A standing workflow, on the schedule you set.</div></div></div><details class="sb-sec sb-acc"><summary><span class="sb-lbl">Works with</span><span class="sb-cnt">15 connectors</span></summary><div class="sb-acc-body"><div class="sb-pills" role="list" aria-label="Eligible connectors" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;white-space:normal;max-width:100%"><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Apollo</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Clay</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Emergent</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Gmail</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Google Calendar</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">HubSpot</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Intuit Mailchimp</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Microsoft 365</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">monday.com</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Notion</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">RingCentral</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Salesforce</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Trello</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Zoho CRM</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Zoom</span></div></div></details><div class="sb-sec sb-none"><span class="sb-b">No connectors?</span> Forward the inquiry to Claude, get the reply drafted to send yourself, and Claude keeps your leads in a spreadsheet CRM.</div></div></div><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-story" style="background:#e0dcec"><div class="sb-lbl">Owner story</div><div class="sb-who">Bambi Baby</div><div class="sb-role">Josh Weiss, COO</div><div class="sb-stats"><div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-num">$60,000</span>in sales tied to the tool in its first four days</div><div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-num">18%</span>of online revenue newly attributed to in-person visits, two weeks into the pilot</div></div><div class="sb-body"><div>At Bambi Baby, a family-owned baby stroller and car seat retailer, about three in four walk-in shoppers left without providing a name or an email. COO Josh Weiss, who is not a developer, used Claude to build a scan-to-wishlist lead capture and the follow-up behind it. In the tool's first four days, $60,000 in sales tied back to it. Two weeks into a two-store pilot, 18% of online revenue was newly attributed to in-person visits.</div></div></div></div><figure data-flush="true"><div class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__video Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__youtubeEmbed Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__video" data-youtube-id="D2FcNf2v9KY"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/D2FcNf2v9KY?enablejsapi=1&amp;rel=0&amp;playsinline=1&amp;modestbranding=1" title="YouTube video" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation allow-popups" allowFullScreen="" class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__player"></iframe></div><figcaption>Claude for Small Business: Speed to Lead</figcaption></figure><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-band" id="sb-proposals" style="background:#dfe6d3"><div class="sb-cal" aria-hidden="true"><span class="sb-cal-d">WED</span><span class="sb-cal-n">04</span></div><div><span class="sb-eye">Wednesday</span><h2>Writing proposals</h2></div></div></div><p>You walk a job site and record a two-minute voice memo on the way back to your office. By the time you sit down there&#x27;s a branded proposal, priced from your past jobs, waiting for your edits. Once you approve, it goes out for signature.</p><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-how"><div class="sb-sec"><div class="sb-lbl">Run it</div><div class="sb-row"><div><span class="sb-tag">Ask</span><span class="sb-q">“turn this into a proposal”</span></div><div><span class="sb-tag">or type</span><code>/proposal-builder</code></div><div class="sb-rnote">First: attach the memo, photos, or RFP, or pull a call transcript.</div></div></div><details class="sb-sec sb-acc"><summary><span class="sb-lbl">Works with</span><span class="sb-cnt">17 connectors</span></summary><div class="sb-acc-body"><div class="sb-pills" role="list" aria-label="Eligible connectors" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;white-space:normal;max-width:100%"><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Apollo</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Atlassian Confluence</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Canva</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Docusign</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Google Drive</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Microsoft 365</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">MYOB</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">NetSuite</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Notion</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">PayPal</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Intuit QuickBooks</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Square</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Stripe</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Trello</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Xero</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Zoho Books</span><span class="sb-pill" role="listitem">Zoom</span></div></div></details><div class="sb-sec sb-none"><span class="sb-b">No connectors?</span> Upload the memo, photos, and a past proposal as your template, and Claude builds and prices from those. You send it for signature yourself.</div></div></div><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-story" style="background:#dfe6d3"><div class="sb-lbl">Owner story</div><div class="sb-who">KANE</div><div class="sb-role">Michael and Joni Kazantzis, co-founders · Princeton, New Jersey</div><div class="sb-stats" style="grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)"><div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-num">Weeks → minutes</span>from scoping a deal to a statement of work out for signature</div></div><div class="sb-body"><div>KANE, a creative and growth agency in Princeton, New Jersey, used to spend weeks per deal on scoping, pricing, proposal writing, and contracting. Co-founders Michael and Joni Kazantzis built a Claude pipeline that scores fit from the meeting notes, prices from their own past projects, drafts the proposal, and has the statement of work out for signature within minutes of a yes. “We've taken an entire process that used to take us weeks and it's done almost within a few minutes in a day, and even the clients recognize that,” Michael Kazantzis said.</div></div></div></div><figure data-flush="true"><div class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__video Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__youtubeEmbed Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__video" data-youtube-id="ZV3oKch1t_I"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ZV3oKch1t_I?enablejsapi=1&amp;rel=0&amp;playsinline=1&amp;modestbranding=1" title="YouTube video" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation allow-popups" allowFullScreen="" class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__player"></iframe></div><figcaption>Claude for Small Business: Proposal Builder</figcaption></figure><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-band" id="sb-marketing" style="background:#ece7da"><div class="sb-cal" aria-hidden="true"><span class="sb-cal-d">THU</span><span class="sb-cal-n">05</span></div><div><span class="sb-eye">Thursday</span><h2>Unblocking marketing campaigns</h2></div></div></div><p>Next week&#x27;s posts are drafted in your voice with on-brand graphics, cut into every format your channels need, and staged for your approval. Last week&#x27;s sales by channel are on one page with your marketing results, and this week&#x27;s new reviews have replies drafted and waiting for your OK.</p><div class="sb-tag">Ask</span><span class="sb-q">“plan next week's content”</span></div><div><span class="sb-tag">or type</span><code>/social-content-engine</code></div><div class="sb-rnote">Keeps the posting calendar full.</div></div><div class="sb-row"><div class="sb-rtext">Runs on a weekly schedule for the numbers and reviews.</div><div><span class="sb-tag">type</span><code>/marketing-monday</code></div></div></div><details class="sb-sec sb-acc"><summary><span class="sb-lbl">Works with</span><span class="sb-cnt">16 connectors</span></summary><div class="sb-acc-body"><div class="sb-pills" role="list" aria-label="Eligible connectors" sb-none"><span class="sb-b">No connectors?</span> Claude drafts the calendar, captions, and design briefs, and builds your weekly page from exported sales and pasted reviews.</div></div></div><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-story" style="background:#ece7da"><div class="sb-lbl">Owner story</div><div class="sb-who">Rebel Cheese</div><div class="sb-role">Kirsten Maitland, co-founder and CEO · Austin</div><div class="sb-body"><div>Kirsten Maitland, co-founder and CEO, launched Rebel Cheese, an Austin plant-based cheesemaker that went from one restaurant to a national e-commerce business after appearing on Shark Tank. The brand voice lived in her head and couldn't scale past her own hours. After vetting Claude on data security, she trained a voice skill on her own writing and connected it to her email and social tools. A teammate now drafts on-brand campaigns without routing every line through the founder. “I live in Claude, running multiple instances simultaneously across two computers to keep up with demand,” she said.</div></div></div></div><figure data-flush="true"><div class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__video Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__youtubeEmbed Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__video" data-youtube-id="z8sq-2SB35w"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/z8sq-2SB35w?enablejsapi=1&amp;rel=0&amp;playsinline=1&amp;modestbranding=1" title="YouTube video" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-presentation allow-popups" allowFullScreen="" class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__player"></iframe></div><figcaption>Claude for Small Business: Social Content Engine</figcaption></figure><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-band" id="sb-close" style="background:#dbe5ef"><div class="sb-cal" aria-hidden="true"><span class="sb-cal-d">END</span><span class="sb-cal-n">06</span></div><div><span class="sb-eye">Month end</span><h2>Closing the books</h2></div></div></div><p>Claude reconciles your books against every place money moves: sales settlements, card spend, and payroll. It flags mismatches down to the transaction, writes a plain-English P&amp;L, and creates a close packet for your accountant. If one account never reconciles cleanly because your POS has no connector, Claude reaches it through Zapier or builds a connector, and the adjustment your bookkeeper makes by hand becomes a saved step in next month&#x27;s close.</p><div class="HtmlEmbed-module-scss-module__yZf7SG__embed" data-html-embed=""><div class="sb-how"><div class="sb-sec"><div class="sb-lbl">Run it</div><div founder and CEO · Dallas</div><div class="sb-stats"><div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-num">16</span>transactions isolated behind a $13,000 discrepancy</div><div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-num">10 seconds</span>for a monthly reporting task that used to take two hours</div></div><div class="sb-body"><div>HireEffect, a Dallas firm that runs bookkeeping, payroll, and HR for small businesses nationwide, had a client whose books carried a $13,000 discrepancy buried in two and a half years and tens of thousands of PayPal transactions. COO Chris Scott used Claude to isolate the exact 16 transactions responsible. “It was literally a needle in a haystack. There's no way we'd have found it without this,” says Founder and CEO Jennifer Scott.</div><div>They also built a governed reporting dashboard across five disparate systems, including QuickBooks and a CRM, that turned a two-hour monthly task into ten seconds; their Director of Bookkeeping built her own skill that turns a client P&amp;L into a visual summary with discussion points already flagged.</div></div></div></div><figure data-flush="true"><div class="Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__video Video-module-scss-module__miVj5a__youtubeEmbed Media-module-scss-module__7ZZCyW__video" data-youtube-id="sD1_ERv4nDM"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/sD1_ERv4nDM?enablejsapi=1&amp;rel=0&amp;playsinline=1&amp;modestbranding=1" title="YouTube video" allow="accelerometer; id="built-for-trust">Built for trust</h2><p>Half the owners we surveyed on the spring tour named data security as their biggest hesitation about using AI. Here&#x27;s how controls work:</p><ul><li><strong>By default, you decide what runs, and when.</strong> Every workflow starts in approval mode. Claude drafts the work and stages it, then waits for your OK. Once you’re comfortable with a workflow, you can let it run on its own. You make that choice one workflow at a time and can switch it back whenever you want.</li><li><strong>Some workflows stop short of the last step. </strong>For instance, Claude stages payroll in Gusto for you to submit.</li><li><strong>Your existing software permissions hold.</strong> If an employee can’t see something in Intuit QuickBooks or Google Drive today, they can’t see it through Claude.</li><li>By default, we don’t train on your business data on Team and Enterprise plans.</li></ul><p>Full details are in our <a href="https://trust.anthropic.com/">Trust Center</a>.</p><h2 id="new-opportunities-for-training-and-enablement">New opportunities for training and enablement</h2><p>Starting this week, the Claude SMB Tour is back with our partner Tenex, running free half-day workshops in <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-boston/rta">Boston</a>, <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-pittsburgh/rta">Pittsburgh</a>, <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-detroit/rta">Detroit</a>, <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-minneapolis/rta">Minneapolis</a>, <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-phoenix/rta">Phoenix</a>, <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-memphis/rta">Memphis</a>, <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-savannah/rta">Savannah</a>, <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-bentonville/rta">Bentonville</a>, <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-tampa/rta">Tampa</a>, and <a href="https://anthropic.swoogo.com/claude-smb-workshop-raleigh/rta">Raleigh</a>. Learn more and register for a workshop, <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/events/build-with-claude">here</a>.</p><p><em>&quot;Lucky to be able to be sitting in that room. The most invested hours of my time that I have had in the last couple of years.&quot; — <strong>Paola Alvarado, President, CORE Boiler &amp; Mechanical Services, Prairieville, Louisiana</strong></em></p><p>We have also begun identifying SMB-focused consulting partners and system integrators in our Claude Partner Network, beginning with <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/1784259993008x356713100372617860">A.team</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/1784259990043x541987221200018940">AnswerRocket</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/bold-tech-partner">Bold Tech</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/1784259945978x195470687185893340">Caylent</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/1784260001823x362151805260541250">First Line Software</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/1784260003108x180366083877681100">Grid Dynamics</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/1784260006158x658004936465662000">LightCI</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/1784260008826x243046775320587400">Loka</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/1784260011304x967968340701961500">Praecipio</a>, <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/rosetree-solutions">Rosetree Solutions</a>, and <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory/partner/the-agile-monkeys-sl">The Agile Monkeys</a>, and plan to <a href="https://partnerhub.claude.com/directory?filters=1789178865067x436833862108438660">add more</a>.</p><p>In the coming weeks, we’ll be announcing community-run Claude workshops hosted by Approved Claude SMB Trainers, who were trained via dedicated, Tenex and Anthropic-hosted “Train the Trainer” events in San Francisco and New York City this summer.</p><p>This fall, the companies behind our integrations will also teach small business owners how to use Claude with the tools they already run on. In the Claude for Small Business partner webinar series, 14 technology partners will each host a free, live webinar on their connector from late September through November. Each session covers what the connector can do inside Claude, how your data moves between the tool and Claude, and a workflow you&#x27;ll run live before the session ends.</p><p>Register here: <a href="https://luma.com/0p7fmc93">Notion</a> (Sept. 25), <a href="https://events.ringcentral.com/events/ringcentral-anthropic-webinar?code=1VT0iDMhkYRYHvCvKuh7xHS1x">RingCentral</a> (Oct. 1), <a href="https://events.zoom.us/ev/AiJIgCaSD_osXZeGeXnc35LGiTBIHdUDmFozuhmTENO1P2oUl3I-~AgAG7IFCoItAIlAIpdM2J7wX0K8l1OTZimYEPk8HrltCwvlqK6sEY7HXfqtWBB5w0i-aA4o-9WIvF50a6y0xYOIbiQ">Zoom</a> (Oct. 8), <a href="https://monday.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_WkuWnYDXQ9GQMisrSzJgpg#/registration">monday.com</a> (Oct. 12), <a href="https://monday.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_WkuWnYDXQ9GQMisrSzJgpg#/registration">Expensify</a> (Oct. 13), <a href="https://events.apollo.io/apollo-claude-growth/">Apollo</a> (Oct. 15), <a href="https://adminhug.info/claude102026">HubSpot</a> (Oct. 20), <a href="https://event.on24.com/wcc/r/5496016/977F305A86D5D6E06F602DE266A993C6">Gusto</a> (Oct. 21), <a href="https://zapier.com/resources/events/claude-smb-zapier-with-anthropic">Zapier</a> (Oct. 22) <a href="https://xero.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_c_4fE7BGRGi35kiIK1OwCA#/registration">Xero</a> (Oct. 27), <a href="https://www.clay.com/livestreams/claude-for-small-business-build-your-growth-engine-with-clay?utm_source=all&amp;utm_medium=influencerpartner&amp;utm_campaign=claude_smb_anthropic">Clay</a> (Oct. 28), <a href="https://www.tiktokacademy.com/student/page/3663358-north-american-europe-putting-ai-agents-to-work-powering-growth-with-tiktok-ads-and-claude-for-small-business?utm_source=partner_site&amp;utm_medium=blog&amp;utm_campaign=anthropic_MCP_261022_partner_enablement_na&amp;utm_content=webinar">TikTok</a> (Oct. 29), <a href="https://www.alignable.com/groups/invite-only-events/events/how-small-businesses-are-growing-with-ai-nov-2026">Alignable</a> (Nov. 5), and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/events/run-grow-andenableyourbusinessw7503923852599525376/">Atlassian</a> (Nov. 17). We&#x27;ll add more in the coming weeks, <a href="https://claude.com/solutions/small-business?tab=virtual#events">here</a>.</p><h2 id="partnering-with-the-community">Partnering with the community</h2><p>We believe AI adoption among small businesses could have significant public benefit through economic growth and employment. That’s why our <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/beneficial-deployments">Beneficial Deployments</a> team works with organizations that support small business owners and entrepreneurs.</p><p>We&#x27;re partnering with <a href="https://www.goldmansachs.com/community-transformation/10000-small-businesses/us">Goldman Sachs 10,000 Small Businesses</a>, the widely recognized leader in practical education for small business owners, which has helped more than 19,000 entrepreneurs across the United States grow their businesses and create jobs. Together, we&#x27;re creating a new learning series on applied AI for small businesses. Globally, we&#x27;re a founding partner of <a href="https://doincuversity.ai/">IncuVersity</a>, a new Program from <a href="https://thedo.world/">The DO</a> that aims to help 20,000 early-career entrepreneurs build businesses with Claude over the coming years. And we are partnering with <a href="https://echoinggreen.org/">Echoing Green</a>, which backs early-stage social entrepreneurs around the world, as they incorporate Claude into their new AI-focused programming.</p><h2 id="getting-started">Getting started</h2><p><a href="http://claude.com/plugins/small-business">Install Claude for Small Business</a> from, say “set me up,” and connect a tool or two. It’s available on every paid Claude plan, and we recommend the <a href="https://claude.com/pricing#team-&amp;-enterprise">Team plan</a> for businesses with more than one person. A step-by-step install guide and workflows list is on <a href="https://academy.claude.com/tutorials/how-to-install-the-claude-for-small-business-plugin">Claude Academy</a>.</p></div></div></div></div><section class="RelatedPosts-module-scss-module__fDzNNG__root" data-cta-section="resourcesRelated"><div class="container"><header
